title: flushSync: update the DOM, then read it

slides.say: You add a todo, then scroll to the last item. It always scrolls to the one before. Why?
State updates are queued. Set todos does not update the DOM right away, so the new item is not there yet when you scroll.
Wrap the update in flush sync from react dom. React updates the DOM synchronously right after it, so the new todo is there when you scroll.

slides.text: Rare tool: use it only when you must read the updated DOM right away.
slides.say: It is a rare escape hatch. Use it only when you need the updated DOM immediately.
